versions.content:
# Cancellations and retention v7 (published 11/3, effective Thursday 11/5 at 08:00, all states)

Changes from v6:
- On every cancellation call, before any retention offer, say: "You can cancel at any time by telling me you
  want to cancel, and I'll take care of it on this call." Then you may present one Offer Library offer.
- Voicemail cancellation requests: call back within one business day, every state.
- Do not ask the customer to call another number or use another channel to finish.
Everything else in v6 still applies.
